Summary: Payment shall be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement.
Quote: Payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 17.4
Notes: Clause 17.5.1 also mentions a part payment released within 10 days of the engineer's recommendation. Clause 17.7.2 specifies interest on delayed payment at the Bank Rate plus 3%.

Summary: 6% deducted from every payment as retention money, subject to a maximum of 5% of the Contract Price.
Quote: the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
Notes: Referred to as guarantee money/Retention Money in the text. Can be withdrawn by furnishing a bank guarantee under Clause 7.5.3.

Summary: 10% of the Contract Price paid as advance payment for mobilisation and equipment.
Quote: The Authority shall make an advance payment (the “Advance Payment”), equal to 10% (ten per cent) of the Contract Price, for mobilisation expenses and for acquisition of equipment.
Notes: Clause 17.2.1 specifies 10% advance with 8% simple interest per annum, payable in two equal instalments (though Annex-III on page 160 mentions three instalments and refers to it as interest-free, the main body contract clause 17.2.1 governs). Recovered through proportionate deductions from Interim Payment Certificates once cumulative certified payments reach 50% of the Contract Price.

Summary: 0.05% of the Contract Price per day of delay payable by the contractor.
Quote: it shall pay Damages to the Authority in a sum calculated at the rate of 0.05% (zero point zero five per cent) of the Contract Price for delay of each day reckoned from the date specified in Schedule - I and until such Project Milestone is achieved or the Works are completed
Notes: Damages are refundable without interest if the works are completed within the Scheduled Completion Date including any Time Extension.

Summary: Price adjustment mechanism applies to the Contract Price based on specified material, labour, and fuel components and indices.
Quote: The following percentages shall govern the price adjustment of the Contract Price:
Notes: Clause 17.8 governs price adjustment with specific percentage weights defined for different work types.

Summary: Performance security equal to 5% of the contract price provided as an irrevocable bank guarantee.
Quote: an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee, for an amount equal to 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price, from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-F (the “Performance Security”).
Notes: Must be provided within 15 days of the agreement. Valid until 60 days after the expiry of the Defects Liability Period.
